reason: Incumbent paired ablations reject simply removing portfolio risk. Test continuous ownership and local downside decisions with immediate cash reuse under unchanged execution.

fixed_rules.momentum_horizons: lookback/2, lookback, lookback*2 equally weighted log returns; expanding observed history before long horizons exist
fixed_rules.replacement: only on scheduled review and when outside twice the position count and challenger exceeds incumbent by 25 percent
fixed_rules.structural_exit: close below trend mean and ten-session momentum negative, or sustained twenty-session low
fixed_rules.downside_alarm: one-session loss > 2.5 preceding volatility or five-session loss > max(6 percent, 2.5 preceding volatility * sqrt(5)), with close below ten-session mean
fixed_rules.reentry: two healthy closes above fast mean, positive fast momentum and intact structural trend
fixed_rules.capital: retain economic units; deploy material idle cash to intact holdings and new eligible leaders; entry caps do not continuously rebalance winners

selection_objective: mean(log(wealth / matched buy_hold wealth) - 0.75 * max_drawdown - 0.002 * max(0, orders_per_year - 20))
frozen_execution: Config() from parent main: 2000000 initial cash, 2.5bps commission, 10bps slippage, 0.005 prior average turnover capacity, next open; no intraday invented fills
retention: Save all trials, source and runner hashes, configs, NAV, targets and fills, including failure. Superseded independent ownership experiments remain separate.
interpretation: Training selects a candidate, not economic acceptance. 2026 was already seen and remains retrospective. No dates or symbol identifiers in production decision rules. No arbitrary-subset or earliest-risk guarantee.
